cues.en: Or I could swear to myself that I will never again

cues.en: eat those foods that I love

cues.en: but are doing all the damage.

cues.en: And I knew that going that route rarely results in the outcome you desire.

cues.en: I thought about the habits and passions that I've developed in my life,

cues.zh: 然后想，我能不能对它们做点微调，
cues.en: and I thought, can I make just a marginal adjustment to them

cues.en: so that they work in my favor as opposed to against me?

cues.en: And so I did.

cues.en: and I've got this passion for being in the outdoors.

cues.en: And so that year,

cues.zh: 但事实是，关键不在于那33条步道。
cues.en: But the truth of the matter is, it's not about the 33 trails.

cues.zh: 你得把这个宏大的目标
cues.en: You have to break this big ambitious goal

cues.zh: 拆解成更可控的决策——
cues.en: down into these more manageable decisions -

cues.zh: 也就是沿途需要正确做出的那些决策
cues.en: the types of decisions that need to be made correctly along the way

cues.zh: 为了提高实现你期望结果的可能性。
cues.en: in order to improve the odds of achieving the type of outcome you desire.

cues.zh: 这甚至不是一次尝试的问题。
cues.en: It's not about even one trail.

cues.zh: 而是那些微小的决定，
cues.en: It's about those tiny little decisions,

cues.zh: 比如当你坐在桌前，
cues.en: you know, like when you are sitting at your desk,

cues.zh: 在一天结束时再多投入一点时间。

cues.en: and in that moment, make the decision to put it down.

cues.en: You go put on your hiking clothes,

cues.en: You get out of the car at the trailhead,

cues.en: and you take one step, you take two steps, three steps.

cues.en: Every one of those steps that I have just described

cues.en: is a tiny little decision that needs to be made correctly along the way

cues.zh: 才能达成最终目标。
cues.en: in order to achieve the ultimate outcome.

cues.en: Now, when I say I want to hike 33 trails in the front country,

cues.en: people think about the decisions at the top of the mountain.

cues.en: That's not what it's about.

cues.en: Because if you don't make the right decision

cues.zh: 当你还躺在沙发上的时候，
cues.en: when you're on the couch,

cues.en: So by the end of the year,

cues.en: I even did a few in the backcountry.

cues.en: the Pier to Peak.

cues.en: In 2009, I got really ambitious,

cues.zh: 对一个至今仍无法安定下来、

cues.zh: 一次专注任何事情超过十分钟的人来说，这野心可不小，
cues.en: and focus on anything for more than ten or ten minutes at a time,

cues.en: But again, it's not about reading 50 books.

cues.en: It's not about reading a chapter, a paragraph, a sentence.

cues.en: It's about that decision

cues.zh: 当你一天结束坐在桌前，
cues.en: when you're sitting at your desk at the end of the day,

cues.zh: 或者躺在沙发上，
cues.en: or when you're lying on the couch,

cues.en: or flicking through your Facebook feed,

cues.en: In 2012, I got really ambitious.

cues.en: I set 24 new year's resolutions.

cues.en: 12 of them were what I call giving resolutions,

cues.zh: 就是做12件慈善的事，而且不用开支票。

cues.en: But it's not without its failures.

cues.en: I tried to donate blood,

cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.en: So, here I was trying to do something to make myself feel good,

cues.en: But one day, I'm sitting under this 40-foot tall eucalyptus tree

cues.en: And so I went home and Googled this,
